title: Safe Call on a Nullable String
instructions:
Complete the function `safeLength` that takes a nullable `String?` parameter called `text` and returns an `Int?`.

Use the safe call operator (`?.`) to return the length of the string. If `text` is null, the function should return null.

For example:
- `safeLength("Tribots")` returns `7`
- `safeLength(null)` returns `null`
hint: Use `text?.length` to safely get the length. If text is null, `?.` will return null instead of crashing.
